title: Pedestrian crossing
task: Park the Husky inside the receiving bay across the pedestrian crossing.
planner: Time-expanded departure lattice with a forward collision-envelope test.
criterion: Positive shortfall below the 460 mm study clearance between the robot collision envelope and the nearest lower-leg or shoe collider.
detail_target: Nearest Husky wheel and operator shoe at the same time.

audit.solver: MuJoCo wheel motors, four wheel/ground contact constraints and free-base dynamics. The human motion is prescribed independently.
audit.collision_measurement: Continuous solver checks target the manufacturer-sized base, wheels and bumper boxes/cylinders against four leg/shoe envelopes. Skin vertices were independently checked against those robot envelopes at 25 Hz. Foot planting applies to the displayed shoe mesh.

steps.text: Observe the picker already walking toward the crossing with a carton.
Search 26 candidate departure times. Select a 1.56 s wait before driving.
Accelerate both wheel pairs and follow the planned straight route through the crossing.
Brake while tracking the marked parking bay.
Verify standstill with the full base footprint inside the receiving bay.

safe.summary: Choose the first departure that preserves the planned separation.
safe.caption: The longer yield leaves clearance as the picker crosses.

steps.text: Observe the picker already walking toward the crossing with a carton.
Search 26 candidate departure times. Select a 0.36 s wait before driving.
Accelerate both wheel pairs and follow the planned straight route through the crossing.
The modeled separation falls below the study clearance limit. Robot–human contact remains zero.
Brake while tracking the marked parking bay.
Verify standstill with the full base footprint inside the receiving bay.

unsafe.summary: Choose the earliest departure allowed by the relaxed separation policy.
unsafe.caption: The front of the Husky enters the study clearance zone behind the passing picker.

revision_actions: Retain the validated crossing motion and human separation criteria without modifying in-motion targeting.
Engage gentle closed-loop driveline park verification wheel braking only after passing the recorded goal time in the clear bay.
